item.title: US wholesale: Lent, Lunar New Year, salmonella define shrimp market
item.description: The shrimp market is narrowly mixed, between the tailwinds of Lent and Lunar New Year, and a major Ecuadorian producer placed on the FDA's 'red list'

item.title: NFI adds Atlantic Fish, High Liner veteran as new science director
item.description: Gina Mortillaro replaces Margaret Malkoski, who is retiring after serving as the National Fisheries Institute's director of scientific affairs for the past 10 years

item.title: Bangkok skipjack tuna prices edge higher as lunar New Year slows Asian trade
item.description: Fishing activity in the Western and Central Pacific Ocean remains sluggish, offering limited supply-side relief to skipjack tuna prices in Thailand

item.title: PNG tuna fleet to shift from group to individual crew certification model
item.description: Under the new approach, each tuna fleet will be responsible for securing and maintaining its own FISH standard for crew certification

item.title: Canadian seafood magnate Risley looks to transfer assets of heavily indebted investment firm
item.description: 'Change is inevitable and I believe this is the right path for the future' -- Clearwater founder and former owner John Risley on a plan to transfer the assets of CFFI Ventures

item.title: Russian, US PBO pollock fillet block prices keep rising with eyes on post-holiday Chinese double-frozen deals
item.description: UCN increased its February ex-coldstore Europe price assessment on both Russian and US single-frozen PBO by $100/t compared to January; Chinese double-frozen prices are also edging up and sources feel more upward pressure coming

item.title: Peru boosts seafood shipments as Asia, Europe lead demand growth
item.description: Peru’s seafood exports soared in November 2025, led by booming demand from Asia and Europe

item.title: Former American Seafoods CEO, Norwegian rocker Bodal gone at 72
item.description: 'His personality filled every room he entered, and his passion for the North Pacific and its fisheries helped shape the spirit of modern Alaska fishing as we know it today' -- American Seafoods

item.title: Chinese-backed company files appeal in Canadian lobster lawsuit
item.description: 'Let me make myself clear to Mr. Mao that we will not be intimidated by him, and he can count on us driving this through to the finish' -- Colin Sproul, United Fisheries Conservation Alliance

item.title: Alaska salted sockeye roe output seen at 100t as processors exit category
item.description: Two major producers are exiting salted sockeye roe production in Alaska, cutting an expected 2026 output to only 100t and effectively ending more than 50 years of supply that helped shape food culture in northeastern Japan
